description: Use this when managing post auto-signatures. Create a reusable auto-signature with the post editor's full RichDocument and optional buttons/media. Assign it with assign_signature. Never publishes.

mediaFile1.description: Actual attached or generated image file, up to 10 MiB: JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP. Pass the file through the client upload mechanism; the server receives download_url and file_id. mime_type and file_name may be omitted. In the same richDocument call, use this slot name as media.src for exact placement.
